title: A Busy Morning at the Cafe

sentences.text: Currently, it is a busy morning at the Sunny Cafe, and the cooperative staff are making coffee constantly.
sentences.translation: 目前,阳光咖啡馆的早晨很忙碌,合作的员工们正在不停地煮咖啡。

chunks.label: 主干(主系表)
chunks.text: it is a busy morning at the Sunny Cafe

grammar.name: 现在进行时 be + doing
grammar.note: are making 由 be(are)+现在分词(making)构成,表示此刻正在进行的动作。

grammar.name: 进行时标志词
grammar.note: currently、constantly 等副词常与现在进行时连用,表示现阶段持续发生的事。

sentences.text: A client is reading the menu while his friend is standing in line.
sentences.translation: 一位顾客正在看菜单,而他的朋友正在排队。

chunks.label: 主干(主谓宾)
chunks.text: A client is reading the menu

chunks.label: 连词(while 引导时间状语从句)
从句(时间状语从句)
chunks.text: his friend is standing in line

grammar.name: while 引导时间状语从句
grammar.note: while 表示"当……的时候",主句与从句都用进行时,表示两个动作同时进行。
grammar.example: She is singing while I am dancing.

grammar.name: stand in line 排队
grammar.note: standing in line 是现在进行时,表示"正在排队"。

grammarTags.phrase: his friend is standing in line
grammarTags.name: while 引导时间状语从句

grammarTags.phrase: his friend is standing in line
grammarTags.name: stand in line 排队

exercises.prompt: 回译:我在跳舞时她在唱歌。
exercises.answer: She is singing while I am dancing.
exercises.note: while 表示"当……的时候",主句与从句都用进行时,表示两个动作同时进行。
exercises.point: while 引导时间状语从句

exercises.prompt: 仿写本句(替换主语或表语):A client is reading the menu while his friend is standing in line.
exercises.answer: A client is reading the menu while his friend is standing in line.
exercises.note: standing in line 是现在进行时,表示"正在排队"。

sentences.text: The attentive waiter is greeting them warmly and is telling them about the special coffee of the day.
sentences.translation: 细心的服务员正在热情地和他们打招呼,并告诉他们今天的特色咖啡。

chunks.label: 主干(主谓宾)
chunks.text: The attentive waiter is greeting them

chunks.label: 主干(主谓宾)
chunks.text: is telling them about the special coffee of the day

parts.text: about the special coffee of the day

grammar.name: 并列谓语用进行时
grammar.note: and 连接两个 be+doing(is greeting/is telling),相同主语可省略,表示同时进行。

grammar.name: tell sb. about sth.
grammar.note: tell 后接人再接 about,表示"告诉某人关于某事"。

sentences.text: The young man is thinking about his order, and he is asking for an additional cup of tea.
sentences.translation: 那个年轻男子正在考虑他的订单,他正在要求再加一杯茶。

chunks.label: 主干(主谓宾)
chunks.text: he is asking for an additional cup of tea

grammar.name: think about / ask for
grammar.note: think about 表示"考虑",ask for 表示"要求、索要",两者都常用于进行时态。
grammar.example: He is asking for more milk.

grammar.name: a cup of 一杯
grammar.note: a cup of tea 是"一杯茶",cup 是量词。

grammarTags.phrase: he is asking for an additional cup of tea
grammarTags.name: think about / ask for

grammarTags.phrase: he is asking for an additional cup of tea
grammarTags.name: a cup of 一杯

exercises.prompt: 回译:他正在要求多加牛奶。
exercises.answer: He is asking for more milk.
exercises.note: think about 表示"考虑",ask for 表示"要求、索要",两者都常用于进行时态。

exercises.prompt: 仿写本句(替换主语或表语):The young man is thinking about his order, and he is asking for an additional cup of tea.
exercises.answer: The young man is thinking about his order, and he is asking for an additional cup of tea.
exercises.note: a cup of tea 是"一杯茶",cup 是量词。

sentences.text: His wife is finding a quiet table near the window and is watching the street with curiosity.
sentences.translation: 他的妻子正在找一张靠窗的安静桌子,并好奇地看着街道。

grammar.name: 介词短语作定语

grammar.name: with curiosity 好奇地
grammar.note: with+抽象名词 表示伴随状态,作方式状语。

sentences.text: Despite the crowd, everyone is feeling happy, and the cafe is full of laughter.
sentences.translation: 尽管人很多,每个人都很开心,咖啡馆里充满了笑声。

chunks.label: 主干(主系表)
chunks.text: the cafe is full of laughter

grammar.name: despite 尽管
grammar.note: despite 后接名词短语,相当于 although+句子,表示让步。
grammar.example: Despite the rain, we went out.
grammar.exampleCn: 尽管下雨,我们还是出门了。

grammar.name: be full of 充满
grammar.note: be full of 表示"充满",后接名词。

grammarTags.name: despite 尽管

grammarTags.phrase: the cafe is full of laughter
grammarTags.name: be full of 充满

exercises.answer: Despite the rain, we went out.
exercises.note: despite 后接名词短语,相当于 although+句子,表示让步。

exercises.prompt: 仿写本句(替换主语或表语):Despite the crowd, everyone is feeling happy, and the cafe is full of laughter.
exercises.answer: Despite the crowd, everyone is feeling happy, and the cafe is full of laughter.
exercises.note: be full of 表示"充满",后接名词。
